title: Facial Recognition Experts Can Identify You by … Your Ears?
sourceName: National Institute of Standards and Technology
content: Carina Hahn is a social scientist in NIST's Information Technology Laboratory. With a Ph.D. in cognition and neuroscience from the University of Texas at Dallas, Carina's research is centered around facial forensic expertise, where she works to understand this specialized type of facial recognition ability. Carina was part of a team that won a gold medal from the U.S. Department of Commerce — the highest honor granted by the secretary.
